henry.title: Will a Pumpkin Float?
henry.intro: It's harvest time in New Mexico! Pumpkins are huge and heavy, but they float. The secret is density: how much stuff is packed into a space.
steps: Open PhET Density and test blocks in the water (5 min).
Read NASA's 'What Causes the Seasons?' to see why fall comes.
worksheet: In the sim, which blocks floated? Which sank?
Finish the sentence: An object floats when it is ___ dense than water.
Predict: will an apple float or sink? A chile pepper? A potato?
Why does the Northern Hemisphere get autumn in October? (Use the NASA page.)
Draw a pumpkin floating in a tub and label 'water' and 'pumpkin'.
links: Click 'Intro', then drag blocks into the water. Which ones float?
Read the short answer and look at the Earth-and-Sun picture.

frankie.title: Apples Grow on Trees!
frankie.intro: In fall, farmers pick apples, pumpkins, and chile. Apples grow on trees and have seeds inside!
steps: Play Apple Picking with Curious George.
Draw and count on your worksheet.
worksheet: Draw 3 apples in the basket. Count them: ___
Circle what grows on a tree: 🍎 / 🥕
Draw the seeds inside an apple
links: Press the green PLAY arrow and help George pick apples!
